verdict_rationale: Three deliverables shipped + smoke-tested. INFRASTRUCTURE IS PROVEN. End-to-end LOAD DISPATCH was NOT demonstrated against this dev DB because Spatie roles are not seeded (only the 'Admin' role exists; 'POS Operator' role missing). The artisan command's preflight quote-mint check (added post-advisor-review) correctly catches this in ~5 seconds and aborts with remediation guidance — converting what would have been a 4-hour fail-late into a 30-second fail-fast. Honest AMBER (per advisor): GREEN would require a demonstrated successful round-trip; AMBER reflects 'infrastructure proven to bootstrap, gates work, preflight fails honestly when env can't run it'. Owner should: (a) seed roles via `php artisan db:seed --class=PermissionTableSeeder` OR use the H.3 provisioning script in storage/logs/h3-provision-fixtures.php to seed POS Operator + Admin roles; (b) re-run smoke `--hours=0.01 --skip-queue-worker-check` to confirm end-to-end round-trip in ~36s; (c) launch the 4h soak per runbook. Three deliverables: (1) app/Console/Commands/E2ESoakCommand.php — new artisan command `foodking:e2e:soak --hours=N` that auto-registers via the existing $this->load(__DIR__.'/Commands') pattern, validated by `php artisan list | grep foodking:e2e:soak`. Lifts the H.3 event-loop pattern (storage/logs/h3-mixed-runner.php) into a production-grade reusable command with: durable JSONL output, per-tick Redis stats, queue-worker precondition assertion, PHP-S latency caveat warning, fiscal-contiguity post-check, outbox dispatch latency percentile computation, cache hit-ratio measurement, 7 enumerated stop-conditions, 7 acceptance criteria with pass/fail evaluator, verdict computation, preflight quote-mint sanity check, php-fpm worker RSS aggregation (sums all children — not just master). (2) scripts/monitor/soak-tick.sh — standalone background monitor with JSONL output (vs h3-monitor.sh printf), 300s default tick (vs H.3 60s — appropriate for 4h), 7-criterion alarm evaluator, LC_ALL=C locale guard (caught and fixed mid-development — FR locale produced 0,7 instead of 0.7 invalid JSON), php-fpm child RSS aggregation. Smoke-tested: 7/7 valid JSON output lines, alarm correctly fires when queue:work missing. (3) Owner runbook embedded below in OWNER_RUNBOOK field. Four constraints surfaced explicitly: (a) queue:work --queue=high precondition hard-asserted in artisan command (skippable with --skip-queue-worker-check) — H3-DEV-01 lineage; (b) PHP -S latency caveat warned at command start, p99 marked INFORMATIVE-ONLY when detected — H3-DEV-02/03 lineage; (c) Vue browser memory deferred (Playwright maintained 4h is fragile per task explicit note); (d) preflight role-seed sanity check — added per advisor blocker, fails ~5s if Spatie roles unseeded with actionable remediation. ZERO frozen-zone touch. ZERO production code modified — only new files in non-frozen paths.

ROOT CAUSE on this dev DB: only 'Admin' role exists in Spatie roles table — 'POS Operator' role missing means cashier created without proper role assignment gets 403 on /api/admin/pos/quote. The preflight catches this in ~5 seconds instead of letting a 4h soak fail silently with all streams skipping forever.

stop_conditions.name: 5xx_count_gt_zero
stop_conditions.signal_source: in-process counter incremented on each batch result

stop_conditions.name: 429_count_gt_zero
stop_conditions.signal_source: in-process counter (F.1 cap was raised; any 429 = regression)

stop_conditions.name: nf525_chain_broken
stop_conditions.signal_source: php artisan fiscal:verify-chain --all (run per monitor tick)
stop_conditions.threshold: absence of literal 'CHAIN OK' in output

stop_conditions.name: rss_growth_exceeds_ceiling_mb
stop_conditions.signal_source: ps -o rss for detected server pid (php artisan serve OR php-fpm master)

stop_conditions.name: outbox_growth_gt_100_per_min_3_consecutive_ticks
stop_conditions.signal_source: domain_events COUNT(*) WHERE dispatched_at IS NULL — windowed delta
stop_conditions.threshold: > 100/min sustained 3 consecutive ticks (queue:work daemon died proxy)
stop_conditions.evaluated: every monitor tick after first 4 ticks accumulate

acceptance_criteria.name: zero_429
acceptance_criteria.rationale: F.1 cap was already raised post-prior-cycle; any 429 = regression to pre-F.1 behaviour

acceptance_criteria.name: fiscal_sequence_contiguous_gap_free
acceptance_criteria.rationale: NF525 §8 — fiscal sequence monotonic per branch, gap-free. Triple defense Cache::lock 5s + DB FOR UPDATE + UNIQUE constraint must hold under 4h sustained concurrent S1 + S3 fiscal allocators

acceptance_criteria.name: nf525_chain_ok_every_tick
acceptance_criteria.rationale: NF525 §9 — audit_logs HMAC chain integrity must be continuous

acceptance_criteria.name: memory_growth_bounded
acceptance_criteria.rationale: PHP-FPM workers shouldn't leak — bounded heap is a healthy-process signature. H.3 measured -3.36 MB over 15 min (memory reclaimed) so 200 MB is a generous ceiling that catches actual leaks

acceptance_criteria.name: outbox_dispatch_p99_under_30s
acceptance_criteria.rationale: Outbox SLO from app/Jobs/DispatchDomainEventsJob.php docblock — production target is p95<2s steady-state; 30s is the 'queue not catastrophically backed up' bar for a 4h soak

acceptance_criteria.name: cache_hit_ratio_at_least_80
acceptance_criteria.rationale: kiosk.menu.branch.{id} + price cache + queue-number cache should be hot under sustained load. Low hit ratio = eviction storm or TTL misconfiguration. Note: cumulative ratio since redis-server start; for window-scoped ratio, diff monitor.jsonl tick deltas

verdict_mapping.GREEN: All 7 acceptance criteria pass + 0 stop_condition hit + 0 abort_reason
verdict_mapping.AMBER: 1 acceptance criterion fails (e.g. cache hit ratio low because traffic mix didn't hit cached paths) but no stop_condition hit
verdict_mapping.RED: 2+ acceptance criteria fail OR any stop_condition hit OR abort_reason set

Reusability shift: one-shot scripts → reusable artisan command + standalone monitor script. F.2/G.1/H.3 were each one-shot owner-runs; this command + script can be re-run anytime, parameterized, or chained into CI nightly if owner desires (currently NOT in CI — owner-driven per command description)
Durability shift: STDERR streaming → durable JSONL with per-batch flush. A 3h59m crash leaves a complete parseable trace. F.2/G.1/H.3 wrote final JSON only at end — mid-run crash = lost evidence.

Acceptance criteria shift: human-narrative judgement → 7 machine-evaluable criteria with explicit pass/fail. Each H.3 finding was prose-judged GREEN by the agent; this command emits a structured verdict.json computable by any reviewer.
